record.fullDescription:
Hourly readings of solar radiation (SORD – parameter code 63301) from monitoring sites in Harris County downloaded from the Texas Air Monitoring System (TAMIS) web interface, which is managed by the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ). The data are presented in pipe-delimited text files that follow "Raw Data Report (AQS)" format.

The records are not geo-coded but do include an AQS Site ID, which can then be linked to the separate geocoded "TCEQ Air Quality Monitoring Sites" dataset.

Note that there is a similar dataset for Montgomery county, but the equivalent queries for Fort Bend county returned no data.
